scenes.head: बिहार विधानसभा में 84 भर्ती!

scenes.head: कौन apply कर सकता है?
scenes.text: अगर आप किसी भी विषय से Graduate हैं और आपकी उम्र कम से कम इक्कीस साल है, तो आप आवेदन कर सकते हैं। ASO को Level-7 का वेतन मिलता है — चवालीस हज़ार नौ सौ से एक लाख बयालीस हज़ार चार सौ रुपये तक।

yt_desc:
Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026 — 84 posts of Assistant Section Officer (ASO) and Assistant Care Taker!

Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya, Patna has re-opened online applications (Advt No. 01/2024) for 79 Assistant Section Officer posts (Level-7, Rs.44,900-1,42,400) and 5 Assistant Care Taker posts (Level-4). Eligibility: Graduate in any discipline, age 21 years and above. Application fee: Rs.600 for UR/BC/EBC/EWS, Rs.150 for Bihar-domicile SC/ST/PwD candidates and all Bihar-domicile women. Selection through Prelims (100 questions, 400 marks) and a descriptive Main exam. Last date to apply: 27 November 2026.

Apply only on the official portal: https://blasrecruit.in
Official website: https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in
